column_description: TEXT. Unique identifier code for the marketplace platform. PK.
TEXT. Human-readable name of the marketplace platform. Example: Market_84.
TEXT. Classification of the platform (e.g., forum, service, marketplace).
BIGINT. Number of days since the platform’s first observed appearance. Example: 168.
TEXT. Current operational status of the platform (active, offline, seized, etc.). Possible values: Active, Closed, Suspended, Under Investigation.
TEXT. Reputation score assigned to the platform. **NULL means reputation has not yet been assessed or is unavailable.**. Example: $65.20 .
TEXT. Analyst-assigned confidence in the accuracy of platform metrics. Possible values: High, Low, Medium, Unknown.
TEXT. Categorical size bucket of the platform (small, medium, large). Possible values: Large, Medium, Mega, Small.
REAL. Average daily transaction volume on the platform. Example: 5388.
TEXT. Estimated number of active users per month. Example: $38,933 .
BIGINT. Number of distinct sellers currently active on the platform. **NULL means seller count could not be determined at snapshot time.**. Example: 985.0.
BIGINT. Number of distinct buyer (acquirer) accounts on the platform. Example: 6009.
BIGINT. Current number of active product listings on the platform. Example: 34834.
TIMESTAMP. Timestamp when this platform record was last refreshed. Example: 2025/2/16 15:29.
BIGINT. Scheduled refresh interval for this record, in hours. Possible values: 1, 4, 8, 24.
